description: Charging station must maintain 99.5% uptime during operating hours (06:00-22:00)
violation_action: Automatic escalation to operations team, customer compensation

description: Energy metering must be accurate within 0.1% tolerance per OCPP FiscalMetering standards
Authorization and transaction start must complete within 5 seconds of ID token presentation
Each connector must be available for use 95% of scheduled operating time
OCPP connection to CSMS must maintain 99% uptime with automatic reconnection
Total Harmonic Distortion must remain below 3% during charging sessions
Internal temperature must not exceed 55C during normal operation
RCD must trip within 30ms of detecting ground fault exceeding 30mA
Emergency stop must disconnect power within 100ms of activation
Charging station firmware must be updated within 90 days of security patch release
98% of initiated charging sessions must complete successfully
Must comply with grid operator load management signals within 60 seconds
Payment terminal must successfully process 99.5% of payment attempts
User display must be operational and readable 99% of operating hours
Charging cables must pass daily insulation test per OCPP GroundIsolationProtection
